title: Bounded public selected-runtime acquisition diagnostics
change: Instrument only download() with one bounded ASCII JSON stderr record on exit. Fields are pinned input identifier, elapsed seconds, actual response bytes read including a block refused at the unchanged deadline, final hostname only, outcome and exception type.
privacy: No URL path/query, request/response headers, body, exception message, credentials, account token or local path is included.
preserved: All original download statements and order reconstruct byte-for-byte after removing the wrapper and three observation statements.
All code outside download() is unchanged.
The fixed seven public inputs, URLs, hashes and selected native-runtime versions are unchanged.
The total 600-second acquisition deadline, 30-second request timeout, one-GiB combined download cap and per-input byte bounds are unchanged.
The original hash verification, no-existing-target test and final rename occur before PASS is reported.
Original transfer exceptions are re-raised unchanged; diagnostic write exceptions cannot replace their outcome.
Normal stdout and final acquisition receipt schema/content are unchanged.
No retry, mirror, cache, network-authority change or additional fetch is introduced.
The workflow differs only in two exact preparer Git-blob pins; reversing them reconstructs the full old workflow.
Source/installed five whole suites remain 209/209 with 29,49,19,17,95 cases; all native14/whole34/GUI30 obligations and limits remain unchanged.

independent_peer.scope: Exact download-body preservation, redaction and diagnostic-error lifetime

verification.new_tests: None: reversible diagnostic-only instrumentation; existing entire strict route remains required.

artifact_scope: Public-safe source and CI evidence only. No downloaded runtime, document or user data.
